items.name: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional
items.why: The flagship AWS credential for production GenAI on Bedrock: RAG, agents, guardrails, cost and security. Directly matches your GenAI CoE and AgentCore work, and is the credential analysts recommend most for engineers on AWS.
items.prep: Free Exam Prep Plan on AWS Skill Builder; 75 questions, 180 minutes. Pair with the free AWS Agentic AI Demonstrated microcredential for hands-on practice.

items.name: AWS Agentic AI Demonstrated (microcredential)
items.why: A timed, live-environment test of troubleshooting and improving Bedrock agents. Free, practical, and a quick win before AIP-C01.
items.prep: AWS Skill Builder; no subscription needed.

items.name: AWS Securing Agent Identities Demonstrated (microcredential)
items.why: Agent identity and on-behalf-of access are the hardest part of agents touching PHI. This proves you can secure them.

items.name: Amazon Connect AI Fundamentals (knowledge badge)
items.why: About 6 hours on AI assistance and AI-driven workforce optimization in Connect. Cheap signal of contact-center plus AI depth; also a good baseline to assign to your migration team.
items.prep: AWS Skill Builder learning plan; badge via Credly.

items.name: AWS Certified AI Business Strategist
items.status: Beta since September 2026; early-adopter badge if passed by 15 Feb 2027
items.why: Tests business cases, governance and scaling AI adoption, not AWS services. Fits a CoE leader who must justify use cases to LOB owners. The beta price window is the cheapest it will ever be.
items.prep: Exam Prep Plan on AWS Skill Builder; 85 questions, 170 minutes in beta.

items.name: Claude Certified Architect – Foundations
items.status: Active; launched March 2026, price raised from USD 99 on 30 June 2026
items.why: Scenario exam on agent harnesses, Claude API, Agent SDK, Claude Code and MCP. Valuable in services firms; check whether your employer's partner status gives access or a discount. It is a single-vendor credential.

items.name: Anthropic Academy courses (API, MCP, Claude Code, Bedrock)
items.why: Free courses with completion certificates, including a track for Claude on Amazon Bedrock and MCP server building. Directly reusable at work.
items.prep: Self-paced on Skilljar; email signup only.

items.name: Hugging Face AI Agents Course
items.why: Framework-neutral agent fundamentals (smolagents, LlamaIndex, LangGraph) with a benchmarked final project. Free fundamentals and full certificates.
items.prep: Unit 1 quiz (80%) for fundamentals; assignment plus final challenge for the full certificate.

items.name: Building AI Agent Harnesses with Strands Agents
items.why: Agent loop to multi-agent orchestration, evaluation and production deployment on the SDK the playbook recommends. Code in aws-samples.

items.name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
items.why: Broad architecture credibility for a principal role. Worth it if you do not already hold it; lower priority than AIP-C01.
items.prep: AWS Skill Builder Exam Prep Plan.

items.name: Google Cloud Generative AI Leader
items.why: Non-technical GenAI leadership credential with free prep. Only useful if you want a multi-cloud signal; AIB-C01 covers similar ground on AWS.
items.prep: Free learning path on Google Cloud Skills Boost.

items.name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
items.why: Foundational. With your experience, go straight to AIP-C01; recommend AIF-C01 to your wider team instead.

items.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty
items.why: No longer available to new candidates. Replaced in practice by ML Engineer – Associate and GenAI Developer – Professional.
